Core services

Focused urology care with modern procedure pathways.

From kidney stone emergencies to long-term prostate and men's health concerns, each service is designed around diagnosis, treatment clarity, and faster recovery.

01

Kidney Stone Treatment

Laser lithotripsy, URS, PCNL and RIRS pathways for stone pain, obstruction and recurrence prevention.

02

Prostate Problems

Evaluation and treatment for enlarged prostate, urinary symptoms, TURP and laser-based options.

03

Male Sexual Health

Confidential consultation for erectile dysfunction, infertility concerns and andrology-related care.

04

UTI & Incontinence

Diagnosis-led care for repeated infections, leakage, urgency, bladder pain and urinary discomfort.

05

Uro-Oncology

Evaluation and surgical guidance for kidney, bladder, prostate and testicular cancer concerns.

06

Pediatric Urology

Care for urinary and genital concerns in children with family-sensitive explanations and follow-up.

About doctor

Jaipur-trained specialist care, explained in language patients can trust.

Dr. Sunandan Yadav is a Consultant Urologist and Andrologist based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, with focused training in urology, minimally invasive surgery and patient-first clinical care.

2018

MS General Surgery, SMS Jaipur

2022

MCh Urology, Government Medical College Kota
